answer.says: Yes, one samosa, if you would. I am not yet hungry, but the warmth is welcome, and it gives me a reason to stay where I am while the news settles in my head.
answer.thought: The chai and the samosa are the small, concrete anchors that hold the abstract day together. I accept the offer not from hunger, but because the act of eating, even a single samosa, marks a pause in the flow of thought, a necessary return to the body before I attempt to draft a reply to Lindner.
